Nicholas Roedl subscribes to the notion that there nothing in the world that an LS V8 can't fix. The original 2.8-liter PRV V6, unloved and unworthy of the DeLorean (at least when new) has been deep-sixed in favor of 5.7 liters of American iron. You all know the advantages of the LS-series: compact and extremely power-dense, it allows folks to put lots of power where a distinct lack of power used to be.
